pricing.spoken: The base price is twelve thousand five hundred rupees per square foot. GST at five percent is extra, and there is an interest-free maintenance security of three lakh rupees.

location.landmark: Near Southern Peripheral Road (SPR) & NH-8 Junction

usps: Private elevator lobby for every apartment
overview.spoken: It is a low-density project of five towers on twelve and a half acres, open on three sides, with a private lift lobby for every apartment and more than eighty percent of the land kept green.

amenities.spoken: There is a forty-five thousand square foot clubhouse with twelve guest rooms, a temperature-controlled infinity pool and two fine-dining restaurants.

objections.price: What range were you thinking of?
objections.location: Sector 79B offers seamless connectivity to both NH-8 and SPR, avoiding central city traffic while keeping Cyber City under 25 minutes away.
objections.think_about_it: Of course, take your time and talk it over with your family. If any questions come up, I'm happy to answer them now.
objections.possession_timeline: Possession is scheduled for December 2029 (3 years). Foundation work is complete and superstructure construction is moving ahead on schedule.

unit_types.spoken: The three BHK homes are eighteen hundred and fifty to twenty-one hundred and fifty square feet, and they are priced from about two point two crore to two point seven crore.
The four BHK homes are twenty-six hundred to thirty-one hundred square feet, and they are priced from about three point four crore to four point two crore.

payment_plan.name: Construction Linked Plan
payment_plan.spoken: It is a construction linked plan: a quarter at booking, a quarter when the superstructure is done, a quarter when flooring and plaster are done, and the last quarter at possession.
